jobs.title: Sales Development Representative DACH (German speaker)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

About the role

This position is hybrid and based in our London or Berlin office, with an in-office expectation of three days per week.

n8n is hiring an Enterprise SDR to generate high-quality enterprise pipeline for our DACH business by prospecting into strategic accounts and creating meaningful conversations with technical buyers.

You will run a targeted outbound motion: researching enterprise accounts, identifying the right personas, crafting relevant outreach, qualifying early-stage opportunities, and partnering with Enterprise AEs to build pipeline.

This role suits someone with outbound SDR experience who is curious about technical products, thrives in fast-growing environments, and brings the structure, resilience, and sales acumen needed to engage senior stakeholders across large organizations.

Responsibilities

  • Generate qualified enterprise pipeline by prospecting into strategic DACH accounts

  • Build targeted account plans with Enterprise AEs, including priority companies, personas, pain points, and outreach angles

  • Research technical and business stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, and related teams to identify where n8n adds value

  • Craft personalized outbound messaging that ties n8n's automation and AI capabilities to account-specific priorities

  • Run outbound sequences across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other channels

  • Qualify prospects through strong discovery covering business needs, technical context, urgency, and fit

  • Partner with Enterprise AEs on clean handoffs, meeting context, and next steps

  • Maintain accurate Salesforce data across accounts, contacts, activities, and opportunities

  • Use Outreach, Salesforce, Apollo, and AI tools to improve prospecting, research, personalization, and follow-up

  • Continuously refine messaging, targeting, and qualification through coaching, feedback, and performance data

Requirements

Must-have

  • German fluency, C1 or higher (native or bilingual speaker)

  • Prior SDR experience, ideally prospecting into mid-market or enterprise accounts

  • B2B SaaS experience with a working knowledge of pipeline generation, qualification, and sales processes

  • Sales acumen across account selection, qualification, and articulating business value early in the cycle; proficient with structured methodologies such as MEDDPICC

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to write thoughtful outreach and hold confident conversations with senior stakeholders

  • Emotional intelligence to build rapport quickly and adapt across technical and executive audiences

  • Proactive, self-starting working style with consistent follow-up and ownership of results

  • Based in London or Berlin and able to work from the office three days per week

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, or similar platforms

  • Experience selling to technical personas or strong interest in automation, AI, or developer tools

  • Track record of quota attainment, President's Club recognition, or measurable impact in a previous SDR role

  • Practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for research, personalization, or productivity

  • Prospecting experience into large organizations, including identifying buying committees and account priorities

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Now, we’re looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to make sure our GTM team scales just as fast - and just as effectively.

🎯 Your main goal will be to enable GTM teams to close more deals faster by providing the knowledge, resources, and training they need to succeed at every stage of the buyer journey.

You’ll be helping us build on early-stage existing foundations (onboarding, certifications, tooling) and take it to the next level as we scale. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a direct line to revenue outcomes.

 

🚀 Build onboarding that shortens ramp time and boosts impact

  • Design and deliver world-class onboarding for new GTM team members across Sales, Customer Success, and Solutions Engineering.

  • Track and continuously improve ramp time through tailored strategies and performance feedback loops.

  • Collaborate with leadership to define what “great” looks like across roles and build onboarding paths accordingly.

📚 Create scalable enablement programs that drive revenue

  • Translate product updates, GTM strategies, and technical concepts into clear, actionable content.

  • Identify knowledge gaps and build role-specific enablement initiatives to address them.

  • Design certifications and training frameworks (e.g. demo, discovery, technical proficiency) to ensure consistency and quality across the field.

🎤 Run high-impact enablement events and internal comms

  • Support the planning and execution of team-wide enablement moments like SKOs, regional kickoffs, and quarterly readiness sessions, partnering closely with sales and revenue leadership on strategy and messaging.

  • Act as the voice of enablement for GTM teams, making sure they have the right information at the right time, through the right channels.

  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and RevOps to sync launches, messaging, and process changes.

📊 Measure what matters and make enablement a growth driver

  • Define and track KPIs to demonstrate enablement’s impact on sales productivity, pipeline velocity, and deal size.

  • Build a competency scorecard with GTM managers to support coaching and performance management.

  • Use insights from sales calls, Gong data, and product usage to continuously refine your programs.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧠 Sales enablement experience in PLG SaaS: You have 4+ years of enablement experience at fast-growing SaaS companies, ideally building enablement from scratch in a PLG environment.

  • 💼 Deal complexity experience: You've enabled teams selling mid-market to enterprise deals (6 to low-7 figures).

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyer fluency: You understand how to sell to technical personas (CTOs, engineering managers) and can translate that into training that resonates with a technical AE audience.

  • 📚 Learning program design: You’ve built high-quality, scalable training programs tailored to different GTM roles and seniority levels.

  • 🗣️ Strong communicator: You excel at turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, and actionable content for sales teams.

  • 🧘 Organized and proactive: You’re structured, self-directed, and take ownership without needing hand-holding.

  • 🤝 Customer-first mindset: You focus on enabling the team to better articulate our value and deliver better buyer experiences.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🤖 Passion for automation and AI: You’re excited by the space we’re building in — and it shows.

  • 🔧 Familiarity with n8n: You’ve used the product (or are eager to start).

Why join us?

This is your chance to build something from the ground up: a high-leverage enablement function in a high-growth company, with a direct line to revenue impact. You'll be joining a supportive, fast-moving, and collaborative team where enablement is viewed as a strategic lever — not a support function. Help us scale our product, our message, and our people.

Apply now — and help us turn our GTM teams into a world-class sales engine.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

As a Senior AI Engineer, you'll drive intelligent features that redefine how users build automations. You'll build AI-powered capabilities, from natural language input to smart suggestions, that make creating workflows faster and more intuitive.

You'll collaborate across engineering, product, and design to bring generative AI and LLM-based enhancements into the core user experience. You'll improve existing AI integrations, develop new ones, and shape how AI powers our product.

You’ll work across the entire AI feature lifecycle:

  • Architect and implement AI-powered capabilities: code generation, intelligent node creation, and workflow optimization

  • Integrate LLM APIs and embedding models for text-to-workflow and natural language code suggestions

  • Design and iterate on prompts to improve model output and user experience

  • Build internal tooling, evaluation benchmarks, and automated testing for AI components

  • Collaborate closely with other engineers to ensure AI features are reliable, performant, and scalable

  • Balance experimentation with impact: ship quickly while focusing on user value

  • Stay current with advances in LLMs, prompt frameworks, and developer tools - and bring those insights into our roadmap

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience building web-based products, ideally in B2B SaaS startups

  • Strong fullstack development skills with TypeScript, Node.js, and API design

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features in production with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and understanding of how to translate machine intelligence into user value. We're looking for experience building end-to-end systems.

  • Understanding of AI fundamentals: agent architectures, chat completion roles, embedding vectors, vector databases, and chunking strategies

  • Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, embedding models, and vector stores

  • A user-focused mindset: you care about delivering features that solve real problems

  • A bias for shipping and learning - fast iteration is second nature to you

Bonus Points For

  • Experience fine-tuning LLMs or working with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

  • Frontend experience using Vue or React

  • Technical writing or documentation contributions, especially around developer tools or AI

  • Experience with agent orchestration patterns and state management in multi-step AI systems

  • Knowledge of code quality evaluation metrics and context optimization techniques

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.


We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on:

  • Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • AI: This team is perfect for designers who've worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows.

  • Growth: We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly.

  • Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms (like e-commerce or talent marketplaces) where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. You'll build something new from the ground up in a brand new team.

Our team structure evolves quickly and these team assignments may shift in the coming weeks.


🎯 Regardless of the team your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n’s user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features with a strong engineering mindset and understanding of the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates’ work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product’s big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You’re proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You’ve shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You’re open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team’s bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You’re enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype or collaborate using HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You’ve designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You’re comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You’ve built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces—shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise features, growth journeys, or a new marketplace—from discovery to delivery. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.



n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.


We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on:

 - Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

 - AI: This team is perfect for designers who've worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows.

 - Growth: We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly.

 - Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms (like e-commerce or talent marketplaces) where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. You'll build something new from the ground up in a brand new team.

 - Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.


RESEARCH, FEEDBACK, AND UX QUALITY

 - Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates’ work.

 - Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.


SYSTEMS THINKING AND PLATFORM COHERENCE

 - Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product’s big picture.

 - Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

 - Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.


STRATEGY, IMPACT, AND INNOVATION

 - Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

 - Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

 - 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies.

 - 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You’ve shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

 - ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

 - 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

 - 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You’re open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team’s bar.

 - 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You’re enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

 - 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.

 - 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype or collaborate using HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.

 - 🧩 AI & automation domain: You’ve designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

 - 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

 - 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

 - 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

 - 📊 Data-informed design: You’re comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

 - 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You’ve built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.

You’ll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces—shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise features, growth journeys, or a new marketplace—from discovery to delivery. About the role

Your goal will be to build and scale a world-class Enterprise Sales organisation across the West Coast - coaching a team of high-performing Enterprise AEs to win complex, multi-stakeholder deals while building a repeatable, predictable engine in one of the most strategically important regions for n8n.

To make that happen, you'll be hands-on in deal strategy, customer exec engagement, and day-to-day coaching—raising the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win.

What you’ll be doing

SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR THE WEST COAST TERRITORY

  • Prioritize and run the West Coast Enterprise territory with focus – balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong

  • Drive deal strategy and execution across complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, including rigorous pipeline inspection and forecast reviews

  • Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical + business wins

BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION

  • Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution

  • Orchestrate executive engagement across West Coast accounts – aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals

  • Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy

DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING WEST COAST TEAM

  • Lead and develop a West Coast Enterprise team with hands-on coaching that improves performance and career growth

  • Hire, onboard, and scale the team over time, establishing operating rhythms that create leverage as we grow

PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS

  • Collaborate cross-functionally (Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, Product) to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process

Requirements

MUST HAVES

  • 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals

  • 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: Deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection

  • 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals

  • 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes

  • 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback

  • 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum

  • 📍 West Coast/Texas location: You’re based on the West Coast and happy being on-site with customers – especially in the Bay Area (we're also open to those based in Texas/Colorado/Washington and willing to travel)

  • 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: Experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions

NICE-TO-HAVES

  • 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion

  • 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: Experience in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories

  • 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down

  • 📊 Operational excellence: Strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and ship end-to-end TypeScript product features that make n8n safer, more scalable, and more programmable for enterprise customers — helping large organizations run business-critical automation with confidence.

To do so, you’ll own outcomes across the full stack and stay close to users, product, security, and enterprise-scale requirements:

Enterprise product ownership

  • Own product surfaces from discovery to delivery across areas like identity, access, governance, APIs, observability, environments, and enterprise integrations.

  • Ship high-quality features fast across the TypeScript stack, balancing usability, security, performance, and maintainability.

  • Partner closely with Product to translate complex enterprise customer needs into clear scopes, technical trade-offs, and measurable outcomes.

Fullstack delivery across platform and product

  • Build and evolve customer-facing experiences in Vue or React for admins, developers, and enterprise users managing n8n at scale.

  • Develop scalable Node.js services and APIs that power authentication, permissions, workflow lifecycle management, observability, integrations, and partner use cases.

  • Move fluidly between frontend and backend codebases to unblock your team and keep momentum high across complex product areas.

Secure, scalable enterprise foundations

  • Build capabilities that help organizations control who can do what across n8n, including authentication, provisioning, RBAC, credential infrastructure, and secrets management.

  • Contribute to safe workflow delivery through environments, source control, versioning, testing, CI/CD validation, and deployment workflows.

  • Improve governance, observability, auditability, and runtime controls so admins can understand, troubleshoot, and enforce how n8n is used.

APIs, integrations, and extensibility

  • Build and maintain enterprise-grade integrations, nodes, SDK capabilities, and execution patterns that support automation at scale.

  • Design APIs, embed capabilities, and multi-instance management features that make n8n programmable for partners, developers, and large customers.

  • Instrument features end-to-end so you can measure impact, debug real-world behavior, and continuously improve reliability for business-critical workflows.

Teams you could join

We’re currently hiring across multiple enterprise product engineering teams, including IAM, Enterprise Nodes, API & OEM, and Governance & Observability. During the interview process you’ll be matched to a team based on your strengths and what you’re most excited to build.

  • Learn more about the teams and their focus areas here.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🧩 Fullstack JavaScript/TypeScript experience: You’ve shipped customer-facing features using TypeScript across frontend and backend, and you feel comfortable working fullstack.

  • 🧠 Product-minded engineering: You talk about users, workflows, and outcomes rather than only implementation details, and you enjoy turning complex customer problems into simple product experiences.

  • ⚙️ Modern web stack fluency: You have hands-on experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and either Vue or React.

  • 🏢 Enterprise SaaS mindset: You understand the expectations of large organizations around security, reliability, scalability, auditability, and administrative control.

  • 🌐 Scalable systems experience: You’ve built or operated high-traffic SaaS systems and understand trade-offs across performance, reliability, maintainability, and developer velocity.

  • 📈 Metrics and instrumentation ownership: You’re used to instrumenting what you ship, measuring impact, and using data to decide what to build, fix, or iterate next.

  • 🧭 Ownership in small-to-mid teams: You’re comfortable wearing multiple hats, navigating ambiguity, and adapting to fast-changing priorities while keeping quality high.

  • 🤝 Collaborative builder mindset: You share knowledge through code reviews, docs, and mentorship, and you thrive in a team that builds together.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔐 Identity, access, or security experience: You’ve worked on SSO, SAML, OIDC, LDAP, MFA, SCIM, RBAC, permissions, secrets management, or credential infrastructure.

  • 🚢 SDLC and deployment workflows: You’ve built features around environments, Git-based workflows, versioning, testing, CI/CD, release controls, or approval gates.

  • 🔌 Integrations and APIs: You’ve built integrations, APIs, SDKs, automation platforms, or developer tooling that helps others extend a product.

  • 📊 Observability and governance: You’ve worked with audit logs, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, SIEM integrations, admin controls, usage insights, or runtime policies.

  • 🤝 OEM or partner platform experience: You’ve contributed to embeddable products, partner platforms, multi-instance management, air-gapped deployments, or enterprise developer portals.

  • 🛠️ OSS and community involvement: You contribute to open-source, build side projects, or participate in developer communities.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a backlog. You’ll build the enterprise-grade foundations that make n8n safe, observable, programmable, and reliable for large organizations running business-critical workflows. You’ll have direct impact across product areas like identity, governance, APIs, SDLC, integrations, and observability, while helping shape how n8n scales for its next generation of enterprise customers.

You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team where autonomy is real, collaboration is valued, and your impact is visible across the product.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

n8n sits at one of the most interesting UX problems in software right now: more than 80% of workflows built on n8n today involve AI agents, and the platform is in the middle of a deliberate expansion from deeply technical developers toward a broader set of builders. That tension, keeping power users happy while dramatically lowering the floor, is the central design challenge.

This is a foundational hire with a real mandate and direct exec partnership.

What you'll do

Own the quality bar

  • Set a clear, consistent quality bar that the team can orient around and build toward, so great work becomes the natural output of how we design together.

  • Build review processes and critique rituals that give the team a shared language for quality and the confidence to make strong craft decisions together.

  • Evolve the design system and QA practices so the bar rises as the team grows.

  • Dig into one of the most genuinely interesting UX challenges in the space: n8n has historically had a steep learning curve for new users. Your job is to lower that floor without losing the power that experienced builders love.

Drive design's strategic influence

  • Shape product strategy, not just respond to it. Bring design thinking into roadmap conversations and help surface user problems before they become someone else's brief.

  • Help lead n8n's expansion toward a broader, less technical audience, a deliberate and exciting strategic shift that design should be leading.

  • Build the kind of relationships with Product, Engineering, and leadership where design is a genuine thought partner at every stage.

Build and grow the team

  • Lead a team of around 14 designers today: 2 Design Leads each working with ~6 ICs, plus Design Engineering and UX Research (with more hires ahead).

  • Shape the team structure, career framework, and progression paths so people know where they stand and where they're going.

  • Create a culture of high standards and honest feedback, where people feel supported to do their best work and have a clear sense of what great looks like.

  • Own hiring and headcount planning for the department, and help us grow without losing what makes the team good.

Build research into how we make decisions

  • Establish a pragmatic, continuous research practice from the ground up. We're making our first dedicated UX research hires, so there's real room to shape this.

  • Make customer insight, product data, and community feedback a live input to product decisions, so teams are building from evidence at every step.

  • Connect research to the decisions that matter most: activation, adoption, retention, and helping new users find their way into n8n with confidence.

Help the team work in new ways

  • Champion practical AI adoption inside the design org, from prototyping and research synthesis to design QA and workflow efficiency.

  • Help the team stay curious and current as the tools, patterns, and expectations around AI products continue to evolve fast.

  • Model the kind of working style you want to see: thoughtful, adaptive, and genuinely excited about what's changing.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🧭 Product design leadership: You have managed managers, coached senior designers, and built design teams that improve both craft and business outcomes, including making hard performance calls when needed.

  • 🧩 Complex product systems experience: You have led design across complex or developer-facing products where UX quality depends on deep product understanding.

  • 🎨 Craft authority: You are a quality bar, not just someone who appreciates quality. You can identify great work, explain why it's great, and hold the line on standards even when it's uncomfortable.

  • 📣 Strategic influence, not just strategic thinking: You have made design a co-equal in product conversations, not a downstream function. You know how to bring people with you, create debate, and drive decisions.

  • 🔀 Structured problem-solving under ambiguity: You find your way into unclear problems and create a plan. You don't just ask good questions, you answer them. You move forward when there's no map.

  • 🤖 AI-era product judgment: You understand the AI, automation, or adjacent tooling landscape and can turn emerging patterns into usable, trustworthy product experiences.

  • 🔍 Research literacy: You know how to build research into product development so insight becomes part of how teams make decisions, not a separate artifact.

  • 📊 Data-informed decision making: You use product analytics, research, and customer evidence to guide decisions instead of relying on taste or opinion alone.

  • 🧱 Org design and performance management: You can design team structures, define career paths, raise expectations, and handle difficult performance conversations with clarity.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌱 Open-source or community product experience: You have worked on open-source, fair-code, community-led, or builder-driven products and understand what it means to design for a community that has strong opinions.

  • 💻 Design engineering credibility: You have enough front-end or design engineering fluency to partner deeply on design system adoption and implementation quality.

  • 🌍 Remote-first operating systems: You have built design rituals, critique, QA, and collaboration practices that work across distributed teams and time zones.

  • 🚀 Growth surface experience: You have worked on activation, onboarding, templates, time-to-value, or product-led growth surfaces.

  • ⬆️ Rising Design Manager profile: We are open to someone who has been an exceptional Design Manager and is ready for their first Head-level role, if the fundamentals are exceptional.

You'd be shaping strategy and operations across a genuinely broad ecosystem, spanning GSIs, affiliates, agencies, resellers, tech partners, education partners, and hyperscalers, with real room to define how it's structured and run rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.

🎯 Your main goal will be to become n8n's dedicated architect of Partner Ecosystem strategy and operations, building the systems, data, and processes that let this fast-growing partner network scale alongside n8n's growth.

  • Own the operational infrastructure powering n8n's global partner ecosystem across reseller and referral segments.

  • Design and maintain partner-attributed pipeline tracking, keeping sourced, influenced, and co-sell deals accurately categorized in Salesforce.

  • Build and maintain channel reporting frameworks covering partner-sourced MRR, activation rates, deal registration, and tier performance.

Partner Performance & Pipeline

  • Support partner pipeline inspection and forecast roll-ups alongside Channel Sales leadership.

  • Develop reporting and insights that drive partner growth and sharpen program performance.

  • Build channel-specific territory and routing logic so partner-sourced leads and registered deals are prioritized and attributed correctly.

Program & Systems Administration

  • Own configuration and adoption of partner-facing tools, including the partner portal and Salesforce's channel-specific objects.

  • Maintain documentation and training materials covering channel processes, rules of engagement, and partner program policies.

  • Manage partner tier qualification, tracking certifications and activity thresholds, while using AI-enabled tools to streamline and scale the work.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Channel Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to operationalize GTM motions like co-marketing campaigns and partner enablement launches.

  • Serve as the channel operations subject matter expert across cross-functional planning cycles, from annual planning to QBRs and GTM launches.

  • Triage and support ad hoc requests, partner escalations, and troubleshooting as they come up.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎯 Channel/Partner Ops experience: You bring 5+ years in Sales Operations or Channel/Partner Operations at a technology company, ideally supporting partner or indirect revenue programs in a high-growth SaaS environment.

  • 🤝 Channel program know-how: You understand channel mechanics like deal registration, partner tiering, co-sell motions, referral fee structures, and margin/discount governance.

  • ⚙️ Salesforce & channel tech stack: You're proficient in Salesforce objects, relationships, and reporting - including channel-specific objects - and you've worked with tools like PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or partner portals.

  • 📊 Data & analytics chops: You're highly proficient in Google Sheets or Excel and comfortable with BI tools, turning partner data into clear insights on contribution and pipeline attribution.

  • 🔍 Precision & attention to detail: You bring meticulous organization and hold your own work to a high standard of accuracy.

  • 🔄 Change management: You've led org-wide change before, especially when operationalizing new program structures.

  • 🧩 Problem-solving mindset: You spot operational gaps quickly and build scalable solutions that move the needle on efficiency and outcomes.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🏅 Salesforce Admin certification: You hold a Salesforce Admin certification, or you're close to earning one.

  • 💻 SQL proficiency: You're comfortable writing SQL queries to dig into partner and pipeline data yourself.

At n8n, you'll be a founding voice in how we scale our partner motion - shaping the systems, data, and processes behind a channel strategy that's still being built from the ground up. You'll work closely with Partner leadership and the broader RevOps team, with the autonomy to drive initiatives end-to-end and the visibility that comes with being a first dedicated hire in this space. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, inside one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

  • Create repeatable one-to-many experiences that allow Solutions Engineers to focus their time on the highest-value and most technically complex opportunities.

  • Ensure partners and global systems integrators have the technical enablement, materials, and support they need to deliver successful customer outcomes.

DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING GLOBAL TEAM

  • Lead a global Solutions Engineering organisation of approximately 15 people (including 2 Team Leads) and prepare the team to scale significantly as n8n grows.

  • Stay close enough to the work to coach through complex engagements, remove obstacles, and help the team execute while the organisation continues to mature.

SHAPING COMPANY AND PRODUCT STRATEGY

  • Represent Solutions Engineering as a senior member of the global sales leadership team, bringing a clear technical and customer perspective to strategic decisions.

  • Act as a key connection between go-to-market and Product, translating field insights into technically credible and actionable feedback.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Product, Product Marketing, and Engineering to improve the full customer lifecycle.

  • Help prioritise the capabilities required to make new products and features demonstrable, deployable, and production-ready for global enterprises.

Requirements

Must haves

  • 🧭 Senior strategic leadership: You have led a Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, or Solutions Architecture function and can operate as a peer within a senior sales leadership team.

  • 🛠️ Strong technical foundation: You can engage credibly with highly technical teams and customers across APIs, integrations, architecture, security, deployment, and enterprise systems.

  • 📈 High-growth scaling experience: You have helped evolve a Solutions Engineering organisation through a period of rapid growth, increasing complexity, and meaningful organisational change.

  • 🏢 Complex enterprise experience: You understand how to support sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and large deployments within global organisations.

  • 🔄 End-to-end customer perspective: You have deep pre-sales expertise alongside meaningful exposure to post-sales, partner, or services-led technical engagements.

  • 👥 Organisational development: You have designed team structures, operating models, and playbooks while coaching managers and developing high-performing technical teams.

  • 🤝 Cross-functional influence: You have worked closely with Product and Engineering and can translate customer requirements into clear, technically grounded insights.

  • 🤖 AI curiosity: You actively explore how AI and agentic ways of working can transform customer solutions, team productivity, and the future of Solutions Engineering.

  • ⚡ Adaptability and ownership: You’re comfortable moving between long-term strategy and hands-on execution in a fast-changing environment where not every process has already been built.

  • 🌱 Values-led leadership: You lead with humility, integrity, and low ego, creating an inclusive environment where talented people can do their best work.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🌐 Open-source experience: You have worked within an open-source or community-led company and understand how community adoption shapes enterprise growth.

  • 🌍 Global leadership: You have managed distributed teams or supported customers across multiple regions and time zones.

This is a remote role, and we are looking to hire people in California or Texas (specifically Austin) only.

As a Customer Success Manager for our Guided segment, you will serve as the primary post-sales partner for a portfolio of approximately 30 enterprise accounts across the US West Coast region, guiding customers from onboarding through scaled adoption and long-term expansion.

You’ll run a strong operating cadence across customer engagements — including kickoffs, success planning, executive business reviews, adoption reviews, and renewals — helping customers translate product usage into measurable business outcomes and clear ROI.

You will proactively manage customer health, identify risks before they become blockers, and drive resolution across technical and business stakeholders. In addition, you’ll help design scalable playbooks and programs that improve customer outcomes across the broader customer base.

Working closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Sales, you’ll turn technical success into durable revenue growth by driving adoption, renewals, and expansion opportunities that contribute to strong enterprise net revenue retention.

 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own a portfolio of n8n enterprise customers, acting as the primary post-sales partner across onboarding, adoption, and renewal

  • Lead customer kickoffs and success planning, aligning stakeholders on goals, timelines, responsibilities, and measurable outcomes

  • Drive onboarding and enablement across technical and business audiences, accelerating time-to-value and unblocking implementation challenges

  • Establish a strong operating cadence (health checks, executive syncs, QBRs), using customer data and adoption insights to guide priorities and decisions

  • Monitor customer health and product usage signals to proactively identify risks, manage escalations, and maintain stakeholder alignment

  • Quantify and communicate business value throughout the customer lifecycle, building ROI narratives tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and business impact

  • Identify and progress expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), partnering with Account Executives on account strategies that drive customer growth

  • Partner closely with Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product teams to resolve blockers quickly and deliver a seamless customer experience

  • Provide structured, actionable feedback to Product and Engineering, representing customer needs and helping shape roadmap priorities

 
 

Requirements

📍Based in Austin, Texas

🤝 Enterprise Customer Success experience

You’ve managed a portfolio of enterprise SaaS customers and can confidently run kickoffs, onboardings, stakeholder alignment, and QBRs end-to-end.

📊 Value & outcomes mindset

You’re comfortable translating product usage into measurable business outcomes, ROI, and executive-ready narratives.

💻 Technical fluency

You can engage credibly with IT and engineering stakeholders across topics like APIs, integrations, authentication, environments, and automation architecture — and know when to escalate.

💼 Commercial acumen

You’ve supported renewals and expansion opportunities (upsell/cross-sell), with a track record of driving retention and growth outcomes.

🧭 Operational rigor

You run a structured operating cadence, manage competing priorities effectively, and keep stakeholders aligned with strong follow-through.

🗣 Clear, high-trust communication

You communicate clearly with both technical builders and executive stakeholders, and you’re known for building durable customer relationships.

🤝 Cross-functional leadership

You partner effectively with Sales, Support, Solutions Engineering, and Product to unblock customers and improve the customer journey.

🌱 Builder mindset in ambiguity

You thrive in fast-moving environments, take ownership, and enjoy building processes as the company scales.

 
 

Nice-to-haves

🤖 Automation + AI curiosity

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Responsibilities

  • Build n8n's Deal Desk function from scratch, AI- and automation-first: intake, approval workflow, and pricing guardrails.

  • Advise Sales on deal structure and pricing to protect margin without slowing down the sales cycle.

  • Maintain a simple set of discount and pricing rules that Sales can apply on their own, without escalating every deal.

  • Run a monthly and quarterly deal war room to keep deal velocity high, especially around month-end and quarter-end close.

  • Handle contract redlines and non-standard terms directly, keeping most negotiations out of Legal's hands.

  • Build a redline clause library of accepted and rejected language, so AI can suggest fallback terms on routine deals.

  • Automate approvals and quoting in CPQ, and use AI to triage incoming requests and flag which deal changes actually need re-approval.

  • Own Salesforce data quality and executed-contract hygiene for every deal.

  • Support Customer Success on non-standard renewal and expansion structuring.

  • Coordinate security and compliance requests (DPA, SOC 2, security addenda) between Sales, Security, and Legal.

  • Report monthly on deal desk performance: cycle time, discounting, and exceptions.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 📈 Deal desk knowledge: You have in-depth experience developing and operating a deal desk function, not just executing a process someone else fully designed.

  • 📐 SaaS commercial fluency: You have a strong understanding of SaaS pricing models, revenue recognition and ARR reporting principles, and enterprise contract structures.

  • ⚖️ Contract negotiation and redlining: You can negotiate and redline order-form-level terms directly with a customer and know when to involve Legal.

  • 🛠️ CPQ/ Salesforce hands-on: You've configured and operated both a CPQ and Salesforce yourself, not just used what someone else set up.

  • 🤖 AI-native working style: You default to AI and automation in your own work, with concrete examples of deal or approval workflows you've automated.

  • 🤝 Stakeholder management: You have outstanding communication skills and can influence and manage complex stakeholders such as Sales, Legal, RevOps, and Finance.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🏗️ 0-to-1 builder: You've spun up a deal desk or similar function from the ground up, defining the underlying processes and policies yourself.

  • 🔧 Modern CPQ/billing exposure: You've worked with Salesforce CPQ or modern platforms like Hyperline or Solvimon.

  • 🧩 Product curiosity: You're curious about n8n and ideally have already successfully built a workflow.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to write thoughtful outreach and hold confident conversations with senior stakeholders

  • Emotional intelligence to build rapport quickly and adapt across technical and executive audiences

  • Proactive, self-starting working style with consistent follow-up and ownership of results

  • Based in London and able to work from the office three days per week

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, or similar platforms

  • Experience selling to technical personas or strong interest in automation, AI, or developer tools

  • Track record of quota attainment, President's Club recognition, or measurable impact in a previous SDR role

  • Practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude for research, personalization, or productivity

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Missions

We’re hiring a Field Marketing Lead to own how n8n shows up at enterprise conferences and field events. You’ll define the strategy, manage the budget, and ensure every event we host or attend translates into real brand presence and pipeline.

You’ll lead relationships with Sales, Partner, and Community teams to ensure we show up at the right events, with the right message, and follow through in a way that moves deals forward. This role reports into Demand Generation and is focused on growing our qualified pipeline for the Sales team.

In this role you will:

  • Own the enterprise events calendar end to end, from selection and logistics to on-site execution and post-event follow-up

  • Manage the events budget directly, making smart tradeoffs across owned activations, sponsorships, and field presence

  • Partner with Sales, Partner and SDRs to align event strategy with pipeline priorities and target accounts

  • Work with Demand Gen to build pre- and post-event programs that turn attendance into qualified pipeline

  • Track and report on event performance, including brand impact, leads generated, and pipeline attribution

  • Represent n8n at key industry conferences and build relationships with event organizers and partners

Requirements

  • Extensive event marketing experience in B2B tech or SaaS

  • You've owned events end to end before - not just supported them

  • Comfortable managing a budget and making calls on where to invest

  • Strong collaborator who knows how to work alongside Sales without losing sight of the marketing objective

Your main goal will be to become the founding owner of Sales Compensation at n8n, building from scratch how we pay and motivate every revenue team across SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise, CS, SE, SDR, and Partnerships, spanning EMEA and AMER. You'll have the mandate to make it AI-first from day one, partnering with our internal AI team to build the agents that run it at scale.

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

Compensation Plan Design & Governance

  • Design, cost, and maintain variable compensation plans for quota-carrying reps and overlay roles (BDR, Partners, SE, CS), aligned with GTM strategy and financial targets.

  • Model plan costs and payout scenarios ahead of annual and mid-year changes, partnering with Finance on affordability and ROI.

  • Own plan documentation, rep-facing comp letters, and FAQs.

Quota & Crediting Operations

  • Implement quotas, targets, and crediting rules correctly across the commissions platform and Salesforce.

  • Own crediting logic for expansions, amendments, multi-year deals, proration, and FX.

  • Partner with RevOps and Deal Desk to keep crediting aligned with how deals are structured.

Commission Calculation & Payments

  • Run monthly and quarterly commission calculations, reconciliation, and dispute resolution.

  • Own the payroll handoff process, ensuring accurate and on-time payouts.

  • Maintain audit readiness and strong internal controls across the full compensation cycle.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Build and maintain reliable reporting on attainment, payouts, and plan effectiveness for Sales, Finance, and RevOps leadership.

  • Surface insights on plan performance and recommend adjustments to keep incentives driving the right behaviors.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales leadership, RevOps, Finance/FP&A, Payroll, People, and Legal on compensation governance.

  • Serve as the go-to expert on comp mechanics, explaining plan design and payouts to reps and executives alike.

  • Support internal-controls work, responding to audit requests related to compensation.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 💼 Comp/RevOps experience: You bring 4-8+ years in Sales Compensation, Incentive Compensation, RevOps, Sales Ops, or Finance within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • 📐 Plan design expertise: You've designed and operated variable compensation plans, including quota-carrying and overlay roles, accelerators, and SPIFFs.

  • 📈 SaaS commercial fluency: You're fluent in SaaS commercial concepts like bookings/ARR, expansions and amendments, multi-year deals, proration, and FX.

  • 🧮 Commissions operations: You have hands-on experience with reconciliation, dispute handling, approvals, payroll handoff, and audit readiness under tight monthly close timelines.

  • 📊 Advanced spreadsheet skills: You're advanced in Excel or Google Sheets - pivot tables, complex formulas, data cleaning, and modeling.

  • 🛠️ Systems fluency: You're comfortable in Salesforce (or a similar CRM) and a commissions platform such as Qobra, CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Varicent, or Everstage.

  • 🗣️ Stakeholder communication: You explain comp mechanics clearly to reps and executives alike, building trust through every conversation.

  • 🔒 Integrity & discretion: You handle sensitive compensation data with high integrity and discretion.

Nice-to-haves

  • 📋 SOX & controls experience: You've worked with SOX/internal controls and commissions accounting or accruals.

  • 📊 BI/reporting tools: You have experience with BI or reporting tooling.

  • 🤖 Automation skills: You're comfortable with SQL, dbt, or scripting to automate parts of the comp workflow.

At n8n, you'll be the first dedicated owner of a mission-critical revenue function - building the systems, processes, and controls behind sales compensation largely from the ground up. You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, inside one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

Apply now - and help us build the future of automation.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We are looking for a highly technical educator and problem-solver to be the technical anchor of our Scaled Enterprise CS team (€20k–50k ARR segment). As a complex, developer-focused platform, n8n requires deep architectural understanding. In this individual contributor role, you won't be managing a traditional 1:1 book of business. Instead, you will act as the "technical unblocker" for hundreds of Enterprise customers simultaneously. You will design and lead one-to-many technical enablement sessions, host live office hours, build advanced workflow templates, and step in for strategic, targeted interventions when our automated systems flag an account that is struggling with architecture or node configurations.

What you'll do

  • Run the technical programs. Lead weekly office hours, monthly deep-dive webinars on the patterns enterprise customers actually struggle with: error handling, AI agents, self-hosting at scale, security and governance, and best practices, lead demos in the weekly group onboarding calls

  • Own the enterprise Slack channel. Be the technical expert in the room — triage, answer, escalate to Product when needed, and turn recurring threads into reusable content.

  • Help with implementation. Jump into activation calls when a customer is stuck. You're not the end-to-end implementation owner — you're the technical assistant that unblocks them and gets them back to self-serve.

  • Partner with other teams to build the playbooks.

    • Reference workflows, integration patterns, security/governance guides, migration guides, AI agent patterns. The library you build is what makes the segment scale.

    • Translate the common questions and hurdles you see in Office Hours/webinars into reusable technical assets.

    • Build advanced use-case templates, video tutorials, and technical documentation that the Digital CS team can distribute in automated campaigns.

  • Build internal automations. When the CS team needs an n8n workflow to automate something internally — health-score triggers, lifecycle alerts, Slack ↔ Vitally syncs — you build it. Best dogfooding in the company.

  • Drive retention through technical health. Identify accounts whose technical setup is fragile (single point of failure, no error handling, scaling issues, brittle credentials) and intervene before that becomes a renewal conversation.

  • Product Feedback Loop. Act as the voice of the scaled technical user. Synthesize the friction points you observe in live sessions and feed them back to the Product and Engineering teams to improve the core n8n experience.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Location: Rights to work in Europe or willingness to relocate to Germany.

  • 💼 Relevant Background: 3–5+ years as a high-performing individual contributor in Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management (TAM), Technical Onboarding, or Developer Advocacy within a B2B SaaS environment.

  • ⚙️ Technical Skillset: Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, JSON, JavaScript, and workflow automation. You understand how backend systems talk to each other and can troubleshoot complex integrations on the fly.

  • 🗣 The "Educator" Skillset: Exceptional presentation and communication skills. You are highly charismatic and comfortable commanding a room (or a Zoom call) of 50+ engineers, developers, or ops leaders, breaking down complex concepts into digestible pieces.

  • 🌱 Scalable Mindset: You possess deep empathy for builders and developers. You have a "solve it once, document it for everyone" mentality, constantly looking for ways to turn a 1:1 solution into a 1-to-many asset.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🎓 Technical degree (e.g., Computer Science, Machine Learning, etc.)

  • 🤖 Hands-on experience with n8n is a massive plus

Why join us? At n8n, you’ll help shape how Customer Success scales at one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups. You’ll have a direct impact on how we support, retain, and grow our Enterprise customers—acting as the ultimate technical unblocker and building the enablement engines that make deep technical success repeatable.

You’ll join a remote-first, highly cross-functional team that values ownership, experimentation, and practical problem-solving. This is a role for someone who wants to blend deep technical architecture with one-to-many education, helping n8n scale from strong customer relationships to a world-class customer experience.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.

 

To do so, here are your responsibilities:

 

OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

  • Lead product discovery for technically complex problems, engaging directly with enterprise customers and internal customer-facing teams.

 

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE

  • Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.

  • Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.

  • Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

 

MAJOR RELEASES & CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Drive the planning and release of major or breaking platform versions, including migration strategy, stakeholder communication, and risk management.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

  • Act as the bridge between the Core team and the wider org: Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Support, making platform trade-offs legible without oversimplifying them.

  • Treat internal product teams as customers of the platform: proactively mine their roadmaps for implicit platform requirements and turn cross-cutting needs into explicit Core Platform work before they become blockers.

 

REQUIREMENTS

 

Must-haves

  • Platform product experience: You have 5+ years in Product, with at least 2 to 3 years on platform, infrastructure, developer-facing, or backend/API products.

  • Technical depth: You're credible with senior engineers. You can reason about distributed systems, execution models, and reliability/scalability trade-offs, and hold your own in an architecture discussion. You're at home with non-functional requirements, where the details are the product.

  • Complex delivery track record: You've led cross-team technical initiatives with real delivery risk, ideally including a migration or breaking change.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or technical-debt work to customer and commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You make complex platform topics understandable for technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments

 

Nice-to-haves

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • Enterprise exposure: You've worked with B2B SaaS requirements like security, compliance, or deployment complexity.

  • Security partnership: You're comfortable working with security teams on code execution, isolation, or compliance topics.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for n8n’s commercial engine and help Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships make sharper, data-driven investment decisions.

To make that happen, you’ll co-own the GTM plan, turn commercial strategy into actionable financial insight, and build the models and operating rhythms that support n8n’s next stage of growth:

DRIVE GTM PLANNING AND FORECASTING

  • Lead n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for GTM, from top-down target setting and cross-functional alignment through to consolidation into the company plan.

  • Build and maintain an integrated sales-led top-line model that reflects the evolving strategies of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships.

  • Partner with other FP&A Managers and Controlling to ensure the company’s forward plan and actual performance are connected, consistent, and interpreted with rigor.

MODEL COMMERCIAL PERFORMANCE

  • Model pipeline health, sales dynamics, funnel economics, and enterprise sales performance to help leadership understand the drivers behind growth.

  • Translate key growth levers such as pipeline generation, conversion, and ACV into clear financial impact and investment trade-offs.

  • Support pricing and packaging analysis, including the impact of commercial decisions on revenue and margin.

PARTNER WITH GTM LEADERSHIP

  • Own the financial partnership with GTM budget owners, helping them right-size investment and make informed decisions before committing resources.

  • Define the KPIs, reporting cadence, and frameworks that improve decision-making, including a consistent approach to marketing ROI, CAC, conversion, and marketing-sourced bookings.

  • Present clear, concise recommendations to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership, including board-level audiences when required.

STRENGTHEN GTM FINANCE OPERATIONS

  • Partner with RevOps on capacity planning, funnel performance, and the financial implications of GTM strategy.

  • Work with Data and Controlling to turn GTM financial reporting into tangible insight and recommendations rather than simply explaining variances.

  • Partner with RevOps and Controlling to forecast sales commission expense as part of the overall GTM budget.

  • Use AI and automation to create repeatable, scalable planning and reporting workflows that reflect how an automation company should operate.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 📊 FP&A expertise: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally within a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

  • 🗂️ Complex planning leadership: You have led multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes from end to end.

  • 🤝 GTM business partnering: You have partnered closely with Sales and Marketing leaders, ideally supporting a sales-led growth or enterprise sales motion.

  • 📈 Enterprise sales economics: You are fluent in CAC, CAC payback, CLV-to-CAC, pipeline dynamics, funnel conversion, and the economics of enterprise growth.

  • 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain reliable as assumptions and business conditions change.

  • 🗣️ Executive communication: You turn complex financial analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to GTM leaders, executives, and board audiences.

  • 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You actively use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your work.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🎓 Relevant education: You have a degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

  • 🏦 Transaction experience: You started your career in transaction advisory, investment banking, or a similarly analytical environment.

  • 🐍 Python skills: You are comfortable using Python to automate modeling, analysis, or reporting workflows.

  • 🧩 Planning platforms: You have worked with financial or headcount planning platforms such as Pigment in complex, multi-entity environments.

  • ☁️ CRM familiarity: You have experience using Salesforce or similar RevOps tooling as a data consumer.

  • 🗄️ SQL capability: You can use SQL or another query language to retrieve and shape data independently.

  • 🌱 PLG familiarity: You understand product-led growth metrics and motions and can collaborate effectively with PLG and R&D finance counterparts.

  • 📊 BI experience: You have worked with dashboarding or BI tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.

  • ⚙️ Relevant industry exposure: You have experience in workflow automation, developer tools, infrastructure software, or a related SaaS category.

  • 🌍 Distributed collaboration: You are comfortable working in a distributed, async-first team with a high degree of autonomy.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll directly shape the financial plan behind our enterprise growth motion, with real visibility into sales strategy, marketing investment, and the decisions that determine how we scale.
